description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brigid, adding {C}{C}.
When Brigid dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Brigid from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Brigid enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind
